notes.title: [Update] 0.0.18 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We have identified and fixed the issue where upgrades were not occurring in the village in the current version. We apologize for the inconvenience.

- An issue where upgrades were not occurring despite consuming resources in the village
- Improved F button responsiveness
- reduced gold consumption for stat upgrades

notes.title: DreamEaterGirl Demo Release
notes.content:
Hello, this is Neon Egg Games.

We are currently a solo development studio and are working on a survival game with charming graphics called DreamEaterGirl.

Although there are areas that need improvement, we will soon be releasing a demo of the progress we've made so far.

We hope to hear a variety of opinions and use them to improve and create a great game.

We would greatly appreciate your feedback!
